scope: Classification of the plugin-manager source-policy mismatch in the Web expected fixture

finding.cause: The creator-plugin-manager expected test creates a temporary bundle directory and passes its absolute path to install_bundle. The current Web bundle intentionally permits only registry install sources, so the production policy rejects the path during installation.
finding.safe_repair: Extend only the test-generated --patch overlay for plugin-manager to allow [registry, path] and retain the existing @deepseek-ai publisher allowlist. Leave packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml registry-only, so production Web behavior remains unchanged.
finding.acceptance: The focused expected test installs the temporary path bundle and completes its restart/removal assertions; the policy configuration and aggregate matrix remain passing except for the independent ContextMeter candidate-tree blockers.

limitations: No production source allowlist is widened.
The test overlay is local to the expected fixture and does not authorize external registry writes or publication.
The worktree remains dirty and no immutable candidate is sealed.
